proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly places Lahnda gā̃ (plural gãī) and Awankari gā̃ (plural gāī̃) under section 3 gāvī. The Pahari-Pothwari Lahndic survey has the same contracted nasalized cow form. This uses the same-region comparator, not nasalization alone: identical-looking Punjabi gā̃ is listed in section 2, so Gujari and Haryanvi homographs are not included.
